name: NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe (30B-A4B)
summary: Open-weight offline speech model from NVIDIA: transcription and speech translation in 40 languages, recordings up to one hour, 65,536-token context. Hybrid mixture-of-experts with about 4.3B active parameters; released in BF16, FP8 and NVFP4. Artificial Analysis ranks it tied #1 among open-weight speech-to-text models at 2.8% WER.

access.notes: Ungated. Permissive: keep the license and notices when redistributing; patent-litigation termination clause. Third-party notices for Qwen3-ASR and vLLM included.

procedure: Open the Hugging Face repo (no login or gate).
Download with `huggingface-cli download nvidia/NVIDIA-Nemotron-3.5-Transcribe-30B-A4B` (about 67.5 GB, single model.safetensors).
Serve or fine-tune with NeMo Speech (github.com/NVIDIA-NeMo/Speech); a live demo is on the nvidia/nemotron-transcribe Space.

verdict.why: Official NVIDIA release, ungated, permissive OpenMDW-1.1 read on the repo LICENSE, independent benchmark (2.8% WER). Heavy download (~67.5 GB) and needs a large GPU for BF16.
